text: {"lessons":["My account value fluctuated over these ten periods despite making no trades, so market movements can affect my savings without any action from me.","These modest ups and downs do not reveal a dependable trend or show which stocks to buy or sell; I should not overreact to short-term results.","Before trading, I should review my actual holdings and prices, respect my cash and share limits, and keep my ten-year apartment goal in view."]}
